name: trader_buy
summary: Buy from the landed trader as the trade window's Buy does: the card is charged, stock drops, goods appear in the pad network's vending machines, then the card holder's inventory. dry_run prices and checks.

help.text: Goods go into the first empty tradable slots, stacked to their maximum; gas into the pad network's atmosphere. Returns {reference_id, name, dry_run, credit_card_id, credits_before, credits_after, results, count, success_count, error_count, delivered, gas_atmosphere_id}. Credits are rounded to the cent; the game keeps no trader currency.
help.keys: reference_id, name, dry_run, credit_card_id, credits_before, credits_after, results, count, success_count, error_count, delivered [{reference_id, slot, item, quantity}], gas_atmosphere_id.

lines.summary: Each line's result and a dry run.
lines.text: results: {index, ok, name, prefab_name, gas, quantity, credits_each, credits_spent (signed: a line with a negative price pays you), stock_after}, or {index, ok: false, name, prefab_name, quantity (bought before the game stopped), credits, error}. A dry run adds the lines up in order, each checked in the game's order (stock, credits, a free slot) against what the lines before it leave, so it reports what a real run would refuse; a line that runs out of room part way is trade_failed with the part it would buy. credits_after in a dry run is the predicted balance, never below 0. delivered lists each new item and where it landed.

credit_card_id.description: The credit card; default the one the player carries.

name.description: The entry's name as trader_inventory gives it; matched first.

prefab_name.description: Breaks a tie between entries of one name, or matches alone.

items.description: Up to 32 lines, each name and/or prefab_name with quantity, traded in order.

dry_run.description: Check and price only; nothing is traded. Default false.
